integrity: Self-contained induction with independent finite checker; numerical limit defined and bounded by recurrences; no independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform self-inverse sampling; fixed binary branching for the density law; inversion-set bijection is not a semigroup morphism. Unrefined involution counts and their exponential growth constant are prior OEIS A332757. Earlier equivalent rank/density formulations may exist.
title: Involution-rank series and a domain-density limit for rooted-tree partial symmetries
